identity.title: B1-B: Bundled pinned forecast, sampling and benchmark parity into native diagnostic consumers
identity.objective: One offline method-comparison vertical: pinned source forecasting, Wang and stratified sampling plus same-cohort scoring parity, consumed by native forecast evaluation and read-only WP170/learning metrics, without changing sealed v1/v2 evidence.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert exactly the 16 declared tracked paths. Historical v1/v2 receipts and existing W01/B1-A Alpha, source/PIT and native stores remain valid and unmodified; only new offline optional method receipts and disposable test data may be written. No provider/host or economic state.

api_matrix.reason: One opt-in, offline method-comparison path over the existing frozen forecast cohort. Historical evaluator entrypoints, receipt identities, WP170 and B1-A remain backward compatible.

items.before: Native four-method forecast evaluator and versioned v1/v2 sealed receipts; no source-method candidate forecast path.
items.after: Opt-in versioned diagnostic candidate forecast/method comparison, using the native scorable row and scoring interfaces, with legacy run/verify behavior preserved.
items.compatibility_requirement: No v1/v2 semantic reinterpretation, historical receipt rewrite, new qualification, learning feedback promotion or change to existing default forecast cases. Additive v3 only if versioned and compatible.

items.before: Finite run/verify over strict frozen v1/v2 cases and cold-verified SRC-01.
items.after: Optional version-aware diagnostic candidate support only; old CLI, v1/v2 cold verify, default v2 outputs, safe replay unchanged.
items.compatibility_requirement: Preserve legacy receipt preimages and pinned code identities for historical verification; no product egress, registry write, provider, generated tracked artifacts or runtime authority.

items.before: Pinned forecast/sampler/metric methods do not have a unified same-case producer and native-consumer trace.
items.after: One thin adapter for pinned source-call/port-parity evidence, actual frozen method inputs and native cohort/metric consumers, with source-dependent refusal.
items.compatibility_requirement: No copied framework, license bypass, second predictor registry, synthetic lift claims, provider network or upstream method impersonation.

items.before: No finite local operator emits one cold-verified upstream-method-to-native-consumer receipt.
items.after: One finite offline run/verify command, write-once receipts, actual frozen source identities and per-ID capability evidence.
items.compatibility_requirement: No daemon, credential, model invocation, live source collection, post-outcome training or modifications to existing B1-A/W01 operator.

semantic_fields.reason: Twelve matched requirements covering actual source-call and parity, frozen native consumers, method receipt compatibility, negative cases, and original capability accounting.

No inference that fake-provider ForecastBot proves an A3 child probability, independent real model behavior, economic edge, or future strategy.
No changes to W01 Hermes, B1-A source/PIT/Alpha consumer spine, runtime policy, original roadmap CSV/archive, PR268 or Lane B.
No new raw outside repo copied into repository, unaudited licensing, dependency/lock/install, scheduler/daemon/agent framework.
No modification of point-in-time market/source records, production Alpha/experiment registry schema/store, canonical WP170 state or OOS run release.
No paper, qualification, order, execution, strategy, risk engine, Gate C, capital, wallet or live trading.
No false 9/36 capability completion, no source-method equivalence without pinned code/fixture proof; unverified rows remain OPEN.
